user.title: Add Machine
user.description: Bind the four physical inputs of an ESP32 node to existing Home Assistant binary sensors. The meaning of every input is configured later in the machine profile.

init.title: Machine profile
init.description: Define what every physical input means for {name}. The semantic state determines how the machine is classified in statistics and on the timeline.

data.no_active_state: State when no input is active

data_description.description: Optional text shown under the machine name
data_description.no_active_state: Used when the machine is reachable but nothing is running
data_description.downtime_threshold: Downtime longer than this counts as a downtime period
data_description.row_order: Comma-separated slots, e.g. input_3, input_1, input_4, input_2
data_description.retention_days: Closed intervals older than this period are removed. Each machine has its own retention.
data_description.shifts: One per line: Name | 08:00 | 20:00. Overnight supported; shifts must not overlap. Times use the Home Assistant timezone.
